price_basis_note: massive_stock_day episodes use raw (unadjusted) name prices vs total-return (dividend-adjusted) benchmark ETFs from yahoo. Excess return is understated for massive-sourced names by approximately the name's dividend yield; material at 126d/252d horizons for high-yielding names.
survivorship_note: Episodes on tickers not in sp1500_pit_membership may be survivorship-biased. Dead names covered via data/edgar/dead_name_prices.parquet where available.
